profiles.notes: Written and verified against the real Notepad. `start` is the same two lines the live tests use; `write` shows how a plan takes its text from `vars`.
From the lab6 run: Eclipse exposes its workbench tree, so `press`/`find` work; the Console maximises with a double click on its tab. Ctrl+F11 re-runs the last launch configuration.
WPS Writer keeps the document text out of UIA, so every read here goes through the pixels (`ocr`) or a screenshot. Verified on the lab6 report: 24 pages, section headers legible at 100%.
The COS console session ran on CDP, not pixels: goto, wait, click, fill, text. These plans keep that order; `{{url}}` comes from `vars`.
The PT8 flow from the lab: the workspace list is the truth about devices, the palette re-arms per device, and the IOS console lives in its own window.
